initialExam.title: AIIMS Nursing Officer 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: All India Institute of Medical Sciences
initialExam.description: AIIMS recruits Nursing Officers for premier government hospitals across India. Highly competitive healthcare recruitment.
initialExam.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc Nursing, registered with State Nursing Council
initialExam.syllabus: Nursing Foundations, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Community Health, Pediatrics, OBG, Mental Health, Anatomy, Physiology.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours. Negative marking 1/3.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Computer Based Test → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Nursing Officer → Sr. Nursing Officer → Asst. Nursing Superintendent → Nursing Superintendent.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit aiimsexams.ac.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, NPA, Medical, Pension, Campus housing, Uniform allowance
